summary: The scoped loader change is coherent, accessible, and validated without modifying proposal data behavior.
findings: Both loading branches now render the same reusable centered animated status; reduced-motion users receive a static indicator and screen readers retain loading context.
evidence_refs: pnpm lint; pnpm build; pnpm exec tsc --noEmit; git diff --check
residual_risks: The loading state is brief under normal localStorage hydration, so animation timing was verified structurally rather than through a prolonged browser capture.
